description: Payment processing and financial infrastructure platform for online and in-person businesses
auth_notes: The Stripe API uses API keys provided via HTTP Basic Auth (username as API key, no password) or Bearer token.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account instantly and generate test/live API keys from the Stripe Dashboard at no cost.
api_notes: Covers payments, subscriptions, billing, invoicing, financial connections, payouts, fraud prevention, and issuing.
mcp_notes: Stripe provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation or resources for AI integration (e.g. stripe/ai or Model Context Protocol docs).
rationale: The API is fully documented, uses standard REST, and provides free self-serve test credentials immediately upon account creation.

evidence.note: Describes API key authentication using HTTP Basic Auth or Bearer tokens.
Stripe Dashboard page for viewing and managing API keys.
Outlines the REST API architecture and endpoints.
References Model Context Protocol (MCP) agent tools under developer resources.
